# Configuration reference

Every setting in `config/application.yaml`, with its shipped default.

**Secrets do not belong in this file.** It is tracked in Git, and the
pre-commit hook refuses a non-empty secret in it. Put real credentials in
`config/application.local.yaml`, which is git-ignored, or reference them
(`env://PRAMA_DB_PASSWORD`).

**`security.session_secret` ships empty on purpose.** A fresh clone
refuses to boot rather than starting with a key everybody knows.

Any setting can be overridden by an environment variable: upper-case the
path and join it with double underscores, so `database.sqlite.path`
becomes `PRAMA_DATABASE__SQLITE__PATH`.

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `app.name` | `Prama` |  |
| `app.environment` | `development` | development \| test \| staging \| production |
| `app.instance_id` | `${HOSTNAME:local}` |  |
| `logging.level` | `INFO` | DEBUG \| INFO \| WARNING \| ERROR |
| `logging.format` | `text` | text (terminal) \| json (log shipper) |
| `security.session_secret` | *(empty)* |  |
| `security.cookies_https_only` | `True` | false only for local http development |
| `tenancy.default_tenant` | *(empty)* |  |
| `server.host` | `127.0.0.1` | bind address; 0.0.0.0 accepts on every interface |
| `server.port` | `5900` | the console and the API share this listener |
| `agents.enabled` | `True` |  |
| `agents.interval` | `60s` | how often due goals are checked |
| `delegates.enabled` | `True` |  |
| `delegates.paths` | *(empty)* | directories of delegate .py files, vetted before import |
| `delegates.entry_points` | `True` | also load the prama.delegates entry point |
| `delegates.disabled` | *(empty)* | names to refuse even if installed |
| `delegates.sandbox` | `True` | run in a resource-limited subprocess |
| `delegates.timeout` | `120` | CPU seconds per run |
| `delegates.memory_mb` | `2048` |  |
| `delegates.max_rows` | `5000000` | a larger dataset is refused, never truncated |
| `codeintake.workdir` | `data/code` | extracted here while read; deleted after |
| `codeintake.timeout` | `300` | seconds the sandboxed reader may take |
| `codeintake.git.allowed_hosts` | *(empty)* | empty: any public host; or e.g. [git.bank.example] |
| `scheduler.enabled` | `False` |  |
| `scheduler.interval` | `60s` |  |
| `scheduler.against` | *(empty)* | a local .duckdb or .sqlite file |
| `scheduler.dialect` | `duckdb` | duckdb \| sqlite |
| `llm.offline` | `False` | true: only self-hosted models on a local or private address |
| `llm.per_principal_rpm` | `60` | requests per minute per principal through /api/v1/llm |
| `web.enabled` | `True` | serve the console alongside the API |
| `web.preview.source` | *(empty)* | a local .duckdb or .sqlite file |
| `web.preview.dialect` | `duckdb` | duckdb \| sqlite |
| `web.preview.max_rows` | `1000000` |  |
| `web.preview.backtest_days` | `30` |  |
| `database.dialect` | `sqlite` | sqlite \| postgres |
| `database.sqlite.path` | `data/prama.db` | ":memory:" is honoured, for tests |
| `database.sqlite.journal_mode` | `WAL` | WAL lets readers proceed during a write |
| `database.sqlite.synchronous` | `NORMAL` |  |
| `database.sqlite.busy_timeout` | `5s` |  |
| `database.sqlite.foreign_keys` | `True` |  |
| `database.postgres.host` | `${PGHOST:localhost}` |  |
| `database.postgres.port` | `${PGPORT:5432}` |  |
| `database.postgres.database` | `${PGDATABASE:prama}` |  |
| `database.postgres.user` | `${PGUSER:prama}` |  |
| `database.postgres.password` | *(empty)* | -> application.local.yaml, or PGPASSWORD |
| `database.postgres.sslmode` | `prefer` |  |
| `database.postgres.application_name` | `prama` |  |
| `database.postgres.schema` | `public` |  |
| `database.postgres.statement_timeout` | `60s` |  |
| `database.pool.size` | `10` |  |
| `database.pool.max_overflow` | `20` |  |
| `database.pool.timeout` | `30s` |  |
| `database.pool.recycle` | `30m` |  |
| `database.pool.pre_ping` | `True` | costs one round trip; prevents stale-connection storms |
| `database.schema_dir` | `schema` |  |
| `database.verify_on_start` | `True` | fail loudly on schema drift rather than migrate |
| `database.echo` | `False` |  |
| `concurrency.supervisor.shutdown_grace` | `30s` |  |
| `concurrency.lease.provider` | `database` | database \| memory |
| `concurrency.lease.ttl` | `30s` |  |
| `concurrency.lease.renew_interval` | `10s` |  |
| `concurrency.lease.clock_skew_allowance` | `2s` |  |
| `plugins.entry_point_groups` | `prama.connectors, prama.backends, prama.monitors, prama.notifiers, prama.scorers, prama.validators` |  |
| `plugins.disabled` | *(empty)* |  |
